text: {"lessons":["A string of months without trading is not a strategy by itself; keep reviewing each holding’s outlook and the portfolio’s risk, even when I decide to hold.","Judge progress against the overall market over a meaningful period, not just month-to-month account changes, and change course only when evidence supports it.","Before adding or trimming a position, consider how it affects total exposure and cash, and use a deliberate position-sizing plan rather than isolated share-count decisions."]}
